verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm a hosted Qdrant cloud offering with a free tier and a free-forever 1GB cluster, so the managed cloud exists. Nothing in the pack documents provisioning those clusters programmatically, such as a cloud management API, CLI or Terraform. Private Cloud is self-run on the user's own Kubernetes rather than fully managed, so it is not credited. missing for 10: first-party docs for the managed cloud service, documented programmatic cluster provisioning (API/CLI/IaC), independent hands-on corroboration of automated provisioning

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a fully managed cloud version of the database with programmatic provisioning

citations.quote: free tier with a free forever 1GB cluster for trying out, no credit card required
Qdrant gets a lot of support from the Rust community and has a slightly more flexible free cloud tier.
